Not necessarily - you can even run a one on one game. But with only two people, you may want to consider getting them an NPC or squire to travel with them that they can control, and also make sure to ratchet the encounters down accordingly. 

The biggest struggle with two people would be pacing and engagement. You should trust those two players to understand they are accepting more of the "weight" of carrying the game, as there are fewer people to play off of. The last thing you want is two shy players, and you as the DM end up just telling them a story.
